# ARC Tech Resilience (Andrews Ritter Consulting)
**Fractional CTO & Infrastructure Architecture**
**Website:** https://arccto.com

## About Us
ARC Tech Resilience provides executive-level Fractional CTO services tailored for SMBs. We specialize in designing Zero-Trust architecture and Crisis-Resilient physical infrastructure. We don't just optimize software; we harden the physical foundation of a business through cyber-physical convergence to ensure aggressive Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and continuous operational resilience.

## Core Competencies
* **Zero-Trust Architecture:** Cryptographic verification for all remote and on-premise workflows, ensuring AI tools and remote staff operate safely without exposing internal data.
* **Cyber-Physical Convergence:** Through a 25-year national partnership, we oversee enterprise-grade hardware, low-voltage cabling, and physical security deployments coast-to-coast. ARC acts as your Strategic Liaison, protecting you from vendor bloat.
* **AI & Automation Integration:** Practical deployment of modular agent clusters and autonomous systems (like the RISE agent and M365 Copilot) to streamline operational friction.

## Engagement Model
We begin all consulting engagements with our **Foundational Tech Audit ($2,950)**, an industrial-grade diagnostic designed to identify single points of failure, consolidate vendor sprawl, and build a "Storm-Proof" technology roadmap.
